newsitem.title: USA: Nichols to buy rest of TXEN for $43.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nichols to buy rest of TXEN for $43.8 mln.

text.p: Nichols Research Corp said Friday it bought the rest of TXEN Inc that it did not already own for $43.8 million in a stock and cash deal.
Nichols said in a statement its board of directors approved the exercise of its option to buy the remaining 80.1 percent of TXEN and merge it with Nichols SELECT Corp, a healthcare subsidiary.
It also said it will take a pretax charge in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 related to the write-off of purchased in-process research and development.
But it said it foresaw the merger becoming accretive to its earnings per share in the next fiscal year.
Nichols said it expected to close the purchase of the managed healthcare services company by August 31.
In December 1994, Nichols bought 19.9 percent of TXEN with the option to acquire all of it in the future.
For the fiscal year ended June 30, TXEN had about $15 million in revenues and about $3.4 million of net income.
Nichols, which provides information technology and technical services, had its stock fall 5/8 to 23 in late morning trade.
